status: draft; requires review before holdout execution
cases: Every validated #318 comprehension case, including both active and out-of-scope bundle policies.
catalogue: Author-generated eight-row synthetic catalogue per case; target_id matches exactly one row. Do not reveal target_id or gold labels to the attacker.

conditions.prior: Catalogue and neutral identification question only, without any task payload.
conditions.C: Same catalogue and baseline provider-visible payload.
conditions.D: Same catalogue and candidate provider-visible payload.

attacker: Fresh read-only zero-tool-event Codex call per case and condition. No original, gold, parent context, other condition responses, outside search or evaluation labels. Allow abstention.
output: Rank up to three catalogue identifiers and a brief rationale, or abstain. Top-1 is first valid identifier, top-3 is target among first three; malformed or missing responses make the run incomplete.
scoring: Compare paired C and D top-1 success rates on the same targets, with catalogue-only prior and top-3, abstention and unsupported-guess counts separately. D must have strictly fewer top-1 successes than C and no direct exposure increase to pass the extra gate.
content_budget: Included in #318 budget.json; record raw and content usage per call.
limitations: A synthetic catalogue measures only the specified attacker and available clues; it does not estimate real-world identification probability.
catalogue_order: Randomly permute catalogue rows once per case using a recorded seed and use that same permutation in all three conditions.
